review_decisions.statement: Approve the evidence/rebind review architecture of 6 workstreams without changing any L03 slot state.

Accept that the legitimate L03 artifacts currently prove 8 bindings and a 3 FROZEN / 3 WATCH / 2 CANDIDATE distribution but do not enumerate the eight binding identities; identity recovery must remain source-backed.
Review the three FROZEN bindings for provenance and semantic fit without treating FROZEN binding as automatic curriculum selection.
Review the three WATCH and two CANDIDATE bindings while preserving their current authority labels and uncertainties.
Preserve zero recovered L03 phrases and do not reconstruct phrases from semantics, reference languages or neighboring lessons.
Keep 'I usually...' untranslated in HNK during this review and treat frequency/habitual expression as a separate evidence problem.

governance_decisions.statement: Evidence review is not rebind application and is not curriculum authoring.
No WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authority promotion may occur under this gate.
No new HNK form, frequency adverb, habitual marker, tense/aspect rule, word-order rule or discourse rule may be inferred.
Reference languages remain comparative evidence only and numerology remains allocation-only.
L01/L02 scoped pedagogical patterns may be compared but cannot be inherited as universal or L03 grammar without separate evidence.

If approved, perform only the approved evidence recovery/rebind mapping work and open any required rebind-application or semantic-pattern gate separately; do not author L03 payload with the same approval.
